title: Jared Osidacz inquest delayed
subtitle: TORONTO - The inquest into the deaths of Jared Osidacz and Andrew Osidacz has been postponed because the venue was too small.
article: TORONTO - The inquest into the deaths of Jared Osidacz and Andrew Osidacz has been postponed because the venue was too small.
Jared, 8, died on March 18, 2006, in Brantford of stab wounds inflicted by his father, Andrew Osidacz, 41, who was later shot during a confrontation with police.
The inquest was supposed to begin Oct 6, at the Brantford Superior Courthouse.

But Dr. David Evans, acting regional supervising coroner for the central Ontario region, said in a statement it has been determined that the courtroom where the inquest was to be held is not large enough to accommodate all of the parties who have expressed an interest in participating in this inquest.
Evans said the inquest is being rescheduled to find larger accommodation.
An announcement will be made at a later date when the inquest location and date have been settled.
Jared was murdered by Andrew Osidacz during a court-ordered, unsupervised visit in March 2006. Hours after
Osidacz had fatally stabbed the boy, he was shot dead by police as he held a knife to Jared's mother Julie Craven's throat.

Despite an Ontario law named for Jared that requires a coroner's inquest whenever a child dies during a court-ordered parental visit, Jared himself isn't getting one because the law wasn't retroactive. Jared's death will be reviewed as part of the coroner's inquest into his father's death.
